import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

const handle = (input: { id: string; name: string }): string => input.id + input.name;

describe('a handler', () => {
  it('handles a command', () => {
    // given
    const input = { id: '1', name: 'a' };

    // when
    const result = handle({
      id: input.id,
      name: input.name,
    });

    // then
    expect(result).toBe('1a');
  });

  it('handles a command without blank lines', () => {
    // given
    const input = { id: '1', name: 'a' };
    // when
    handle({
      id: input.id,
      name: input.name,
    });
    // then
    expect(input.id).toBe('1');
  });
});
